title: Categories and tags
goal: Places added at random can be organised later
acceptance: Filter by category and tag together, and group places by category or tag, including places with no value

Rename a category or tag across every affected place, merge into an existing value, or delete and reassign to another value or clear it; the server applies the change in one transaction and merged tags are de-duplicated
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the owner-approved upfront plan; implementation, local checks and CI #28 passed 2026-11-27. No actual: job timing is unavailable.
